biggest_catch: The bonus MATCHES your first qualifying direct deposit up to $250 — deposit $100 and you only get $100 — and the deposit must post within 30 days; P2P, merchant payments, and transfers from your own bank accounts do not count.
catches: The bonus matches your first qualifying direct deposit up to $250 — a smaller deposit means a smaller bonus.
The qualifying direct deposit must post to your new iSAVE Free Checking account within 30 days of opening.
Qualifying deposits are employer/payroll/benefits via ACH only; check deposits, P2P (PayPal/Venmo), merchant transactions, and non-employer bank ACH do not qualify.
The bonus is paid within 45 days of account opening.
Age 18+; existing Propell checking account holders are excluded.
An iSAVE Savings account is required to open iSAVE Free Checking.
Discovery sources describe this as an in-branch offer; the official page does not state a channel, so in-branch availability should be confirmed before visiting.
Pennsylvania local membership context; no stated expiration — subject to change or termination at any time.
